summary: NexPoint Capital, Inc., a non-traded Delaware business development company, filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that as of July 31, 2026, net asset value per share and the distribution reinvestment plan issuance price were determined to be $4.67 per share under Rule 2a-5 valuation policies approved by the board and administered by the investment adviser. No transaction, stake, premium, advisor or closing date is stated. NA V and DRP pricing updates are ordinary periodic events for non-traded BDCs, not a special situation; no arbitrage angle applies.
